newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish Feb domestic debt rises to 3,605 trln lira.
newsitem.headline: Turkish Feb domestic debt rises to 3,605 trln lira.

text.p: Turkey's domestic debt rose 6.5 percent to 3,605 trillion lira at the end of February, from 3,386 trillion in January, the Treasury said in a statement on Thursday.
It said T-bills with less than one-year maturity made up 1,669 trillion lira of the total domestic-debt stock and bonds having one-year or longer maturity made up 1,514 trillion.
In January, the T-bills were 1,647 trillion lira and bonds were 1,317 trillion lira.
Central bank's cash advances to the Treasury stood at 422.4 trillion lira in February, almost unchanged from 421.2 trillion in January, but up from 371 trillion at end-1996.
Turkey's domestic debt stock grew by 131.4 percent to 3,149 trillion in 1996, including 1,528 trillion lira of t-bills and 1,250 trillion lira of bonds.
